lines: And one more, free of charge...!
Eeeeek!! We're sorry!! Stop it, please!!!
Having been beaten to a pulp, the male gangster was slumped on the ground, holding both arms up.
What the hell! What's with that brat?! She's too strong!! She's too strong, big sis!!!
Nyahaha♪ I wouldn't go that far~♪
Sakura had utterly defeated the gun-wielding gangsters without even using her Ninja Art.
(I-I knew it, her strength is ridiculous...)
(Well, she's "Sakura-sensei" but young, so I guess it should be obvious...)
I recalled how I hadn't been able to move for about two days after being beaten up by Sakura-sensei during a training class.
Hmm~? Fuma-kun, don't tell me you were too scared to move even a bit?
I was standing by, ready to provide backup at any moment. So that if you got into a pinch, I'd be ready to help right away!
(Damn... she's nagging me about the same exact things as Sakura-sensei...)
In reality, the fight had simply been over before I had even had time to think about what to do.
Heh~? Glad I can count on you, Fuma-kun~♪
O-Of course!! Now that that's taken care of, let's head out quickly. We have no business in a place like this.
Yeah, you're right! I'm hungry after all that exercise♪
We turned our backs on the pummeled gangsters and started to walk away. ーBut then.
W-Wait a moment!! You guys, hear me out for a second!!
Still sitting on the ground, the female gangster strained her voice to shout.
Huh? What's up? Still gonna pick a fight?
You don't know when to give up! One more then...
N-No! Wait! I'm not gonna mess with you anymore...
Hmm? I mean, seems like you don't have the strength left to do anything anyways.
I now know just how strong you guys... or rather, how strong she is.
Then what do you want from us?
You said you're looking for work, right?
We were actually looking for strong fighters like you. How about getting in on the action...?
Upon hearing the unexpected suggestion from the mouth of the female gangster, we reflexively looked at each other.
